ValidationRule.description: PO Number and PO Amount are required when Date Order Fulfillment Sent is populated- excludes DRCMI
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT( ISPICKVAL( NCSP_Service_line__c , "DRCMI")) && NOT( ISBLANK( Date_Order_Fulfillment_Sent__c)) && ( ISBLANK( PO_Amount__c ) || ISBLANK( PO_Number__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a value for the PO Number and PO Amount
